youtube.title: Rebuilding a Hebrew emblem from shapes and typed text: draft 1 scored 72/100
youtube.description:
Rebuilt from shapes and typed Hebrew: draft 1 scored 72/100 against the reference, draft 32 scored 79/100.
The emblem was rebuilt with funkbox poster tools from typed text and shapes (shield, ribbon, Hebrew set right to left), each draft scored with poster_compare, then saved as SVG. Two mashups scored 85/100 and 84/100.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
